name: 白底/纯色底产品主图

prompt_template.subject: {product_description}
prompt_template.lighting: soft diffused studio lighting, even illumination

overrides.background: gradient from dark to light, premium feel

category_tips.beauty: emphasize texture and glow, show formula details
category_tips.electronics: highlight metallic finish, screen details, port precision
category_tips.food: vibrant colors, fresh appearance, show texture
category_tips.fashion: show fabric texture, drape quality, stitching details
category_tips.home: show material quality, craftsmanship, lifestyle appeal
category_tips.jewelry: macro detail, sparkle and cut quality, luxurious lighting

examples: {product}, professional product photography on clean white background, soft diffused studio lighting, centered, 8K, commercial e-commerce photography, no shadows, no props
{product} on pure white seamless background, bright commercial studio lighting, centered, 3/4 profile, high resolution, marketplace ready, {material_description}
{product} floating slightly above white surface, softbox overhead, sharp rim light on edges, professional packshot, 8K, ultra-detailed textures

composition_rules.platform_reserved: 国内电商主图：顶部中央 200×100 区域留空（价格叠加区）；左上角 200×100 完全留白（logo 区）

angles.prompt: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
tight zoom on surface texture, extreme close-up

text_rules.default: 纯白底主图通常无文字；国内平台主图可加一句核心卖点 ≤10 字，颜色 #2D2D2D
text_rules.note: 海外平台（Amazon 主图）禁止任何文字和图形叠加

workflow: 确认平台与比例（默认 1:1，用户指定优先；Amazon 主图必须纯白底无文字）
以 prompt_template 为骨架替换 {variables}，按需套用 variants / category_tips
按 composition_rules 写明产品占比、留白、平台预留区
背景必须写死 #FFFFFF，禁止只写 white background
结尾否定清单：道具、手、水印、假 logo、额外文字、渐变背景、杂乱阴影
出图后检查背景是否纯白、产品是否居中
pitfalls: 反光过曝有 AI 感
